name: 2v2 deployment robustness: dose-response extension to the LOW tier, all three families
authority: PI, 2026-09-08: 'freeze and run the already-defined low-tier robustness extension ... completes the original frozen ladder without inventing a post-hoc severity after seeing the medium/high results.'
amends: ROBUSTNESS_2V2_TEST_MATRIX_AMENDMENT.json#NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_RECORD (low tier reserved as a future dose-response extension) and ROBUSTNESS_2V2_DOSE_RESPONSE_HIGH_TIER_AMENDMENT.json (the high-tier sibling of this record, already sealed).
WHY_LOW_TIER_NOW: the medium/high results (ROBUSTNESS_2V2_RUNG1_RESULT.json, ROBUSTNESS_2V2_HIGH_TIER_RESULT.json) left every R_A/R_B interval straddling zero for localization noise and motion error, and control delay was only ever tested at one severity (medium). Completing the ALREADY-FROZEN low tier -- not inventing a new one -- is the only way to get a genuine 3-point severity curve without the sequence (see a result, then pick a value) this program has avoided everywhere else. 0.03 (localization/motion) and 1 tick (control delay) were frozen in DEPLOYMENT_ROBUSTNESS_SPEC.json#TIERS before ANY 2v2 robustness episode of any severity ever ran -- this record selects an already-fully-specified tier, exactly as the high-tier amendment did.

SCOPE.control_delay_low: AUTHORIZED -- delay_ticks=1 (fills in the missing lower point against the existing control_delay_medium=2-ticks result)
SCOPE.control_delay_high: NOT AUTHORIZED. Remains declined per the PI's own prior direction ('the last level is fine') and ROBUSTNESS_2V2_DOSE_RESPONSE_HIGH_TIER_AMENDMENT.json#SCOPE_DECISION. This record does not reopen that decision.
SCOPE.episodes_added: 3 families x 1 severity x 4 cells (z0@A, z1@A, z0@B, z1@B) x 128 seeds = 1536 episodes
SCOPE.nominal: NOT re-run -- reuses the already-collected nominal CSVs (same checkpoint, same seed block), identical reasoning to the high-tier amendment: nominal is severity- and family-invariant.

SEED_BLOCK.block: 13400001..13400128 -- the SAME block already reserved for this study, reused deliberately for the same paired-design reason as the high-tier extension (same seeds -> the SAME nominal trajectories already on disk anchor R_A(low)/R_B(low) exactly as they anchor R_A(medium)/R_B(medium) and R_A(high)/R_B(high)).

POLICY_UNDER_TEST.frozen: identical checkpoint to the medium- and high-tier studies. Not retrained, fine-tuned, or reselected.

CODE: no code change needed -- reuses eval_deployment_robustness.py's existing --families/--skip-nominal flags (built for the high-tier extension) unmodified. One combined invocation per (pole, z) cell with --severities low --families localization_noise,motion_error,control_delay covers all three families' low-tier cells at once.
PRIMARY_QUANTITIES: identical definitions and identical bootstrap (paired percentile, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7) to every other tier in this study: per-condition crossover (delta_A, delta_B, gate) and paired degradation vs nominal within seed (R_A, R_B).

FACTUAL_STATE_BEFORE_THIS_RUN_disclosed_.localization_noise: 2 of 3 tiers tested (medium, high) before this amendment
FACTUAL_STATE_BEFORE_THIS_RUN_disclosed_.motion_error: 2 of 3 tiers tested (medium, high) before this amendment
FACTUAL_STATE_BEFORE_THIS_RUN_disclosed_.control_delay: 1 of 3 tiers tested (medium) before this amendment
FACTUAL_STATE_BEFORE_THIS_RUN_disclosed_.note: any prior claim that all three levels were tested for any family was incorrect; corrected before this extension was authorized.

STOPPING_RULE: exactly one severity extension (low), for all three families except control_delay_high (still declined), on this one checkpoint. No further tiers or families are authorized by this record.
SEQUENCE: freeze this record (done) -> run 3 families x 1 severity x 4 cells on the frozen block, reusing existing nominal -> report per-condition gate AND paired R_A(low)/R_B(low) against nominal -> assemble the full low/medium/high dose-response table for localization and motion, and the low/medium table for control delay -> update the figure/caption only after the result is sealed. Kept fully separate from the concurrent 4v4 confirmatory crossover result -- neither interprets the other.
